te: Yohannan Sulaqa professes his Catholic belief and is ordained as bishop shortly after; this marks the beginning of the …
dz: Yohannan Sulaqa宣称他信奉天主教,不久后被任命为主教;这标志着迦勒底天主教会的开始.
de: Yohannan Sulaqa professes his Catholic belief and is ordained as bishop shortly after; this marks the beginning of the Chaldean Catholic Church.

t: 简·格雷夫人继承了英国王位.
te: Lady Jane Grey takes the throne of England.
dz: 简·格雷夫人继承了英国王位.
de: Lady Jane Grey takes the throne of England.

t: 把简·格雷夫人安放为英国女王的尝试在仅仅9天后就崩溃了.
te: The attempt to install Lady Jane Grey as Queen of England collapses after only nine days.
dz: 把简·格雷夫人安放为英国女王的尝试在仅仅9天后就崩溃了.
de: The attempt to install Lady Jane Grey as Queen of England collapses after only nine days.

t: 迈克尔·塞维图斯被约翰·卡尔文以异教徒身份在瑞士日内瓦逮捕.
te: Michael Servetus is arrested by John Calvin in Geneva, Switzerland as a heretic.
dz: 迈克尔·塞维图斯被约翰·卡尔文以异教徒身份在瑞士日内瓦逮捕.
de: Michael Servetus is arrested by John Calvin in Geneva, Switzerland as a heretic.

t: 英格兰女王玛丽一世的加冕礼在威斯敏斯特礼堂举行.
te: The coronation of Queen Mary I of England is held at Westminster Abbey.
dz: 英格兰女王玛丽一世的加冕礼在威斯敏斯特礼堂举行.
de: The coronation of Queen Mary I of England is held at Westminster Abbey.

t: 作为异教徒被谴责,迈克尔·塞维图斯被烧死在日内瓦外的木桩上.
te: Condemned as a heretic, Michael Servetus is burned at the stake just outside Geneva.
dz: 作为异教徒被谴责,迈克尔·塞维图斯被烧死在日内瓦外的木桩上.
de: Condemned as a heretic, Michael Servetus is burned at the stake just outside Geneva.

t: 劳塔罗手下的马普切叛军击败了西班牙征服者并处决了智利总督佩德罗·德·瓦尔迪维亚.
te: Mapuche rebels under Lautaro defeat the Spanish conquistadors and executes the governor of Chile, Pedro de Valdivia.
dz: 图卡佩尔战役:劳塔罗手下的马普切叛军击败了西班牙征服者并处决了智利总督佩德罗·德·瓦尔迪维亚.
de: Battle of Tucapel: Mapuche rebels under Lautaro defeat the Spanish conquistadors and executes the governor of Chile, Pedro de Valdivia.
